title: l1qw.30(a): C deaddrop response-code contract (5.03 storage_full, 4.13, Location-Path/Max-Age on POST)
description: Smallest child of worker6-l1qw.30 (spec 18.9, R-12-079/085/087): lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c — (1) POST success (2.04 at :205) must add Location-Path (deaddrop/<msg-id>) and Max-Age options per spec; (2) store-full admission failure must return 5.03 Service Unavailable with the storage_full diagnostic (not the current generic 5.00 at :163-179 — check which arm fires when lichen_dtn_buffer_message returns false); (3) payload > MAX_PACKET_SIZE must return 4.13 Request Entity Too Large (currently folded into other codes); (4) keep rate-limit 4.29 semantics unchanged. Mirror the Python deaddrop resource (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py) which conforms and is vector-tested. Diagnostic body shape must match Python/deaddrop.json vectors. Zephyr-coupled file (no host harness) — verification via cppcheck gate + review; note the coap_dtn host-test gap for the test-infra follow-up.
close_reason: C deaddrop response-code contract (spec 18.9) landed in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c: (1) 4.13 Request Entity Too Large (COAP_MAKE_RESPONSE_CODE(4,13)=141, matching the deaddrop.json request_entity_too_large vector) for payload_len > CONFIG_LICHEN_DTN_MAX_PACKET_SIZE, checked statelessly before rate limiting per the Python resource's ordering; (2) storage exhaustion now returns 5.03 Service Unavailable with CBOR body {reason:'storage_full', retry_after:3600} (content-format 60) instead of the blanket 4.00 — the emitted field set matches the deaddrop.json storage_full_rejection vector's expected cbor_payload exactly; available_kb deliberately omitted (slot-driven rejection makes byte-based availability misleading — reviewer-confirmed); (3) success path (2.04 CHANGED) unchanged. Verified: zcbor encode bounded (36 bytes in body[40], bounds-checked with body_len=0 fallback), mutex discipline preserved (encode under lock, respond after unlock), cppcheck gate exit 0. Codereview 3x (Kimi K3): security pass cleared the available_kb disclosure question (both responses post-OSCORE/local-admin gate; OSCORE responses AEAD-encrypted so no passive leak; retry_after constant no DoS), edge pass confirmed 4.13-before-rate-limit ordering matches Python and the expired-record race is mutex-serialized; correctness pass + confirmation pass caught two real defects in my first cut (nonexistent COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE enum -> MAKE_RESPONSE_CODE; LICHEN_DTN_MAX_PACKET_SIZE -> CONFIG_-prefixed macro; body[32] undersized -> 40) — all fixed. Known verification limits: coap_dtn.c is Zephyr-coupled (no host harness) — compile verified via in-tree symbol cross-checks + cppcheck; twister-side runtime check deferred to the nightly (host-test gap tracked for the test-infra follow-up). Max-Age/Location-Path response options deferred: coap_oscore_respond_resource has no options parameter — tracked for the by-id child (vkkt) which introduces drop ids.
